**The free, open-source video editor for creators.** Animated captions, one-click Auto Edit, motion graphics and 4K export, with no subscription, no watermark and no account. Everything runs on your computer.

## 🆕 What's new in this version

- **✍️ Animated text & lower thirds**: 12 motion-graphics templates (pop, slide and neon titles, typewriter, quotes, name lower thirds, chapter tags, a breaking-news banner, and subscribe/follow buttons) in the new **Text** tab
- **🎯 Auto zoom on key words**: automatic punch-in and push-in zooms on the important moments of your video, found from the captions
- **🎚 Auto-ducking**: background music dips automatically while someone is talking
- **👀 Visual template previews**: every effect shows exactly what it does, transitions play on hover, and caption styles appear on black
- **⌨️ Shortcut cheat-sheet**: press `?` (thanks @GhostCoder6969, our first contributor! 🎉)

## ✨ Everything else

25 animated caption styles · offline auto-captions (whisper.cpp) · Auto Edit (remove silences or cut to the beat) · 43 effects & transitions · picture-in-picture & keyframes · voice noise reduction · 9:16 / 16:9 / 1:1 / 4:5 up to 4K

## ⬇️ Which file do I download?

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `…_x64-setup.exe` (or `.msi`) |
| Mac with Apple chip (M1–M4) | `…_aarch64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel chip | `…_x64.dmg` |
| Linux | `.AppImage`, `.deb` or `.rpm` |

FFmpeg and whisper.cpp are included. For auto-captions, open **⚙ Settings → Auto captions** and download a model once.

**First launch:** on macOS, right-click the app → **Open** (it isn't notarized yet). On Windows, SmartScreen may ask: **More info → Run anyway**.

🐞 Found a bug or have an idea? [Open an issue](https://github.com/pankya1801/Clipmaster/issues/new/choose). If Clipmaster saves you a subscription, a ⭐ helps others find it.
